name: agentos-chrome-cdp
description: Control exact existing Chrome profiles through an authenticated localhost chrome.debugger bridge.
long_description: Provides Codex-compatible exact-profile Chrome tabs, locators, raw CDP, event streaming, screenshots, history, clipboard, coordinate input, page File plus DataTransfer injection, profile-bound page asset export, durable virtual-list capture, and a verification-handling module (challenge detection, hold/resume, human handoff, overlay dismissal, humanized input, slider/checkbox solvers, OCR/ASR backend capture). It never launches a debug profile or remote-debugging port.
